situation: A nightly PR check prints the prompt then waits for a terminal user until the runner times out.
correct: D: run Claude Code with -p and provide the review prompt non-interactively.
why: Plan mode, a shared slash command or a CLAUDE.md line do not change the execution mode; only print mode does.
observe: Same evidence as UC-18; compare with running plain `claude` in a terminal, which waits for input.
rubric: the learner can say which of the four options changes execution mode
